description: Panel power meters M1M 15, M1M 20 and M1M 30 (RS485 Modbus RTU or Modbus TCP)
source: ABB, "Modbus protocol map for M1M 15, M1M 20, M1M 30 power meters" V1.3C (9AKK107991A8720) and "M1M Power Meters Modbus manual" 9AKK108467A2704 [1.3]

sources.title: Modbus protocol map for M1M 15, M1M 20, M1M 30 power meters
sources.note: Integer Table, Float Table and Details sheets

notes: ABB M1M 15, M1M 20 and M1M 30 panel power meters; the product column of each register says which models have it.
Addresses are as sent on the bus. FC03 reads, FC16 writes. Multi-register values are big endian, high word first.
A register the meter cannot measure in its wiring (e.g. phase voltages in 3 3T) reads 0xFFFF.
The integer table gives powers with 2 decimals; the registers from 0xCB1A give them in whole W/var/VA for large values. The float table repeats the main values as float32.
Settings that belong together (CT and VT ratios, the RTU settings, date and time) must be written in one request.
Digital outputs follow Modbus only when their type is set to COMM on the display.
Modbus TCP versions (M1M 20/30 Ethernet) use port 502.
